items.html: *Now, regarding the aspect of the light of the forehead, it is sometimes mentioned in the Zohar in this language: ‘When the upper forehead is revealed, etc.’ And the matter is that the abundance of light in that place causes an illumination to be extended and expand downward. And since in the Rosh of Adam Kadmon is the place of the Mochin within it, which are HaVaYaH of AB, and their seat is within the head, inside, while the forehead covers and conceals them, facing them, and there was the place of coupling — the lights of the Mochin called AB, with the lights of the ear, nose, and mouth called SAG. Therefore, from this very place, which is the forehead, aligned opposite the Mochin, from there came out this new light, MA, born from the above coupling. And this light that came out from the forehead expanded from there downward, and its essential existence stood from the navel of Adam Kadmon downward, until near the end of his legs.
